<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="24" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600">9:41</text>
    <rect x="324" y="14" width="22" height="11" rx="2.7" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="326" y="16" width="16" height="7" rx="1.4" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="347" y="17" width="1.3" height="4" fill="#E4E6EB" fill-opacity="0.4"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="19" r="2.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <circle cx="371" cy="16.5" r="2.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <circle cx="377" cy="14" r="2.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="19" r="2.2" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <line x1="310" y1="20" x2="318" y2="20" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="82" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700">Settings</text>
    <text x="24" y="105" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Manage preferences and account options</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile summary card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="23" y="122" width="344" height="98" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="24.5" y="124" width="344" height="98" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.08"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="171" r="24" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="52" y="178" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">MJ</text>
    <text x="88" y="160" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Maya Johnson</text>
    <text x="88" y="181" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">@mayajournal</text>
    <rect x="88" y="188" width="78" height="22" rx="11" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="127" y="203" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600">Pro Reader</text>
    <text x="336" y="160" text-anchor="end" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Updated today</text>
    <text x="336" y="181" text-anchor="end" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">9 devices</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Section title -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="253" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Preferences</text>
    <text x="350" y="253" text-anchor="end" fill="#1877F2" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Edit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Settings list -->
  <g>
    <!-- Notification -->
    <rect x="16" y="267" width="358" height="66" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="267.5" width="358" height="66" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="300" r="14" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="292" x2="42" y2="300" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="305" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="68" y="292" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Notification</text>
    <text x="68" y="313" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Push alerts, email digests, breaking news</text>
    <polyline points="346,292 353,299 346,306" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="299" x2="361" y2="299" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Security -->
    <rect x="16" y="340" width="358" height="66" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="340.5" width="358" height="66" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="373" r="14" fill="#00BA88"/>
    <rect x="37" y="368" width="10" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="372" x2="42" y2="377" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="379" r="1.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="68" y="365" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Security</text>
    <text x="68" y="386" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Password, login activity, two-factor auth</text>
    <polyline points="346,365 353,372 346,379" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="372" x2="361" y2="372" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Help -->
    <rect x="16" y="413" width="358" height="66" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="413.5" width="358" height="66" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="446" r="14" fill="#F4B740"/>
    <text x="42" y="452" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1C1E21" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700">?</text>
    <text x="68" y="438" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Help</text>
    <text x="68" y="459" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">FAQs, support center, report a problem</text>
    <polyline points="346,438 353,445 346,452" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="445" x2="361" y2="445" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Dark mode section -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="517" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Appearance</text>
    <rect x="16" y="531" width="358" height="74" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="531.5" width="358" height="74" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="568" r="14" fill="#FFD789"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="564" r="7" fill="#1C1E21"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="563" r="4.5" fill="#FFD789"/>
    <text x="68" y="559" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Dark Mode</text>
    <text x="68" y="580" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Reduce glare and save battery on OLED</text>
    <rect x="306" y="553" width="40" height="24" rx="12" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="565" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

    <text x="24" y="634" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Account</text>
    <rect x="16" y="648" width="358" height="58" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="648.5" width="358" height="58" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="677" r="14" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="677" x2="48" y2="677" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="671" x2="50" y2="677" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="683" x2="50" y2="677" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="68" y="683" fill="#FF84B7" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Logout</text>
    <text x="340" y="683" text-anchor="end" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400">Sign out</text>
    <polyline points="346,670 353,677 346,684" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="677" x2="361" y2="677" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Additional content cards -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="731" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Recent activity</text>

    <rect x="16" y="744" width="358" height="58" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="744.5" width="358" height="58" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="773" r="14" fill="#34EAB9"/>
    <text x="42" y="778" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1C1E21" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700">1</text>
    <text x="68" y="770" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Signed in from iPhone 14</text>
    <text x="68" y="789" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Today, 8:12 AM · Brooklyn, NY</text>

    <rect x="16" y="808" width="358" height="58" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C"/>
    <rect x="16.5" y="808.5" width="358" height="58" rx="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.06"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="837" r="14" fill="#F4B740"/>
    <text x="42" y="842" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1C1E21" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700">2</text>
    <text x="68" y="834" fill="#E4E6EB" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">Privacy policy updated</text>
    <text x="68" y="853" fill="#B0B3B8" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Mar 12 · Review changes in security</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.04"/>
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="40,790 30,798 50,798" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <rect x="33" y="798" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="40" y="833" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1877F2" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <g>
      <rect x="116" y="790" width="16" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="116,808 124,801 132,808 132,790 116,790" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="124" y="833" text-anchor="middle" fill="#667080" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="195" cy="799" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="201" y1="805" x2="207" y2="811" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="195" y="833" text-anchor="middle" fill="#667080" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="278" cy="794" r="7" fill="#667080"/>
      <rect x="267" y="804" width="22" height="10" rx="5" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="278" y="833" text-anchor="middle" fill="#667080" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Settings active -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="350" cy="799" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="350" cy="799" r="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <line x1="350" y1="789" x2="350" y2="785" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="350" y1="813" x2="350" y2="817" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="340" y1="799" x2="336" y2="799" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="360" y1="799" x2="364" y2="799" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="350" y="833" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1877F2" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Settings</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
